key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut to open and close Superbar.

key.name: clipboard-monitor-enabled
key.description: Continuously monitor the clipboard to build history.

key.name: clipboard-history-limit
key.description: Maximum number of clipboard entries to remember.

key.name: clipboard-history-clear-request
key.description: Internal counter used to clear clipboard history in the running extension.

key.name: max-results
key.description: How many results to show in the search bar at once.

key.name: adaptive-ranking-enabled
key.description: Prioritize previously selected applications and system actions.

key.name: ranking-history
key.description: Internal history of selected application identifiers and named system actions.

key.name: bar-width
key.description: Width of the Superbar in pixels.

key.name: bar-position
key.description: Vertical position of the Superbar: top, center, or bottom.

key.name: theme-mode
key.description: Color theme for Superbar: system, light, or dark.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the Superbar background surface.
